name: Lighthousekeeper’s Vow
body:
Lighthousekeeper’s Vow

School transmutation [meditative]; Level adept 0, hunter 1, investigator 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour
Components V, M (carrots worth 2 cp)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours or until discharged

You attune your mind to the world around you, extending your senses into the realm beyond simple sight. When weather conditions would reduce the range of your vision by one-quarter, you reduce it by only one-fifth. When they would reduce your vision by half, you reduce it by only two-fifths. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on skill checks to notice objects more than 1 mile away and to perceive lights in the darkness.

When you would have to make a saving throw, skill check, ability check or initiative roll due to failing a Perception check affected by this spell, you can discharge this spell to roll twice and take the better result.
